observedFailure: B01 Chromium 145 process exited SIGTRAP before a context returned. Full original error is 4908 bytes/SHA efe9433a9513d896acfbbae53a27159bd658aa08c81a93fb49bd1384f1b658d6; retained sanitized error is not truncated. Only missing CPU frequency Crashpad reads are logged; exact trap cause remains unobserved. B02 and C01 were unrun.

nextCandidate.concreteHarnessDefect: Browser TMPDIR was 68 bytes before Chromium's unique-directory/socket suffix, risking Linux AF_UNIX overflow. Chromium source fatals when its full socket path exceeds sockaddr_un.sun_path.
nextCandidate.causality: This is a source-supported harness defect and candidate repair, not a claim that prior SIGTRAP's precise cause is proved.
changes: Short owned /tmp/tl-* task root and prelaunch socket-path budget assertion; all ownership checks retained.
External runner Playwright updated from 1.58.2 to currently verified 1.64.1 and its bundled Chromium; no app dependency change.
